page.title: Lessons
page.subtitle: A guided path from your very first move to playing chess with solid basic ideas.

path.sectionDescription: Start with the pieces. Short explanations, immediate practice and your coach beside you.

coach.clickToChange: Click the coach to change it.
coach.pathIntro: We will start with one of the easiest pieces to understand. Ready to move a rook?
coach.pathComplete: Nice work. You already understand how the rook moves, gets blocked and captures.

intro.coach: The rook moves in straight lines: horizontally or vertically. It can travel several squares if the path is clear.
intro.body: Look at the rook on d4. During this lesson you will move it, spot blocked paths and use it to capture.

horizontal.coach: Let's start horizontally. Keep the rook on the same rank.
horizontal.instruction: Move the rook from d4 to g4.
horizontal.hint1: Horizontal means moving left or right without changing rank.
horizontal.hint2: The rook starts on d4 and the target is g4.
horizontal.hint3: Follow the straight line from d4 to g4.

vertical.coach: Now the same idea vertically: keep the rook on the same file.
vertical.instruction: Move the rook from d4 to d7.
vertical.hint1: Vertical means moving up or down without changing file.
vertical.hint2: Both squares are on the d-file.
vertical.hint3: Follow the straight line from d4 to d7.

blocked.coach: Straight lines have one important limit: the rook cannot jump over pieces.
blocked.question: The white pawn on a3 blocks the rook on a1. Can the rook move directly to a5?
blocked.success: Correct. The pawn blocks the a-file, so the rook cannot pass through it.
blocked.error: Not this time. Rooks cannot jump over pieces.
blocked.hint1: Look at what sits between a1 and a5.
blocked.hint2: The pawn on a3 cuts the path.

capture.coach: A rook captures by moving onto an enemy piece along a clear straight line.
capture.instruction: Capture the black pawn on a6 with the rook.
capture.success: Perfect. The path was clear, so the rook could capture on a6.
capture.hint1: The pawn is on the same file as the rook.
capture.hint2: There is nothing between a1 and a6.
capture.hint3: Move straight from a1 to a6.

control.coach: Even without moving, a rook controls every clear square along its rank and file.
control.instruction: Click any square the rook on d4 controls.
control.success: Yes. That square lies on the rook's rank or file.
control.hint1: Look only along the horizontal and vertical lines from d4.
control.hint2: The highlighted cross shows the squares controlled by the rook.

combined.coach: Final one: use everything together. Move straight, respect blockers and capture when the path is clear.
combined.instruction: Capture the black pawn on d7 with the rook on d4.
combined.success: Excellent. You found the clear vertical capture.
combined.hint1: The target is on the same file as the rook.
combined.hint2: Check the d-file between d4 and d7.
combined.hint3: The rook can travel directly from d4 to d7.

completion.coach: That's the rook. Straight lines, no jumping, and captures along a clear path. Good first step.
completion.title: Rook basics complete
completion.body: You can now move a rook horizontally and vertically, recognise blockers and make a basic capture.

feedback.legalOffTarget: That move is legal, but it does not answer this exercise. Try the requested idea.
feedback.rookDiagonal: The rook cannot move diagonally. It only moves horizontally or vertically.
feedback.blocked: There is a piece in the way. The rook cannot jump over it.
feedback.illegalAction: That move is not legal in this position. Try another square.
feedback.wrongSquare: That square is not controlled by the rook from here. Look along its rank and file.
